# Independent finite mutation comparison

This package reads frozen source expectations and passive actual envelopes. It
does not invoke the compiler or provide expected data to an observer.

The frozen 114 mutation IDs have five distinct internal authorities, plus four
separately attributed driver boundaries. Internal qualification requires exactly
110 mutations in each of debug/release. The CLI accepts multiple explicit roots,
rejects duplicate tuples, and requires the complete 220-tuple set unless an
explicit bounded --allow-subset development check was requested.

Each envelope is bound to its exact request, controller/parser/overlay/build and
binary identities, source request, baseline and mutant receipts, and observed
artifacts. The baseline receives the same full source comparison as the 152-case
source corpus. Loaded source contents and display associations are validated
before any raw or outcome conditional. Mutable wrapper or expected inputs are
never supplied to an observation adapter.

application.py proves the prescribed edit against complete before/after actual
raw graphs, not a marker alone. It selects the frozen category and occurrence,
compares every untouched field, checks actual binding roles/edge identity, and
reconciles recorded before/after markers. Audit and constructor seams use their
actual journals/maps/identity facts. Missing evidence fails closed.

The outcome driver preserves these boundaries:

- Source association rejects before a raw graph or generic verification
- Association auditing rejects before generic verification, with safe origins
- Raw verification starts and rejects without yielding a checked witness
- Same-signature wrong targets and raw-safe cleanup mutations keep a verified
  witness and fail source correspondence; they are not mislabeled malformed OIR
- Diagnostic metadata probes pass identical cloned raw graphs to the generic
  verifier and retain the original denial kind while source association or
  diagnostic correspondence rejects the mutated origin
- The explicit original-file-ID1 positive translates only frozen expected span
  file IDs, checks every actual raw span against the actual constructor map,
  and compares its original result, paid operations and writes

All actual runtime journals remain in their observed order. The separately
reviewed source comparator v5 governs operation, effect, exact owner/loan keys,
and narrowly scoped same-Return release membership.

The original wrong_scalar_result request selected a unit-only call fixture.
The independently reviewed source-only applicability supplement preserves the
original request bytes and 114-ID roster, correcting that one positive control
to an existing frozen i32-call fixture before its first mutation execution.

The eleven envelope corruption controls and structural application controls are
offline mutations of retained observations. They add no compiler coverage.
Source corpus runs, mutation runs, baseline passivity checks, native executions,
and four driver-boundary attributions are reported as separate domains.

Controller identity is selected by exact mutation ID: the original controller
for the ordinary matrix, the restricted effective-request controller for only
raw-wrong_scalar_result, and the restricted identity-observation controller for
only source-association-stale_parser_generation. Their exact hashes and overlay
pairings are pinned. Historical controller/source paths remain readable.

The original-file1 terminal-check gap and its reproduced pre-fix acceptance are
retained in original-file-terminal-gap.json and the exact comparator snapshot.
The corrected special positive now checks empty activation/loan state and a
committed terminal operation on success; its dropped-commit control rejects.

The first complete actual matrix matched218/220; both cause-metadata mutations
were rejected by the comparison because its expected correspondence failure was
missing. Their E0311 diagnostics legitimately remained byte-identical. The frozen
design already requires exact stored-origin correspondence regardless of selected
rendering. The source-only diagnostic-origin supplement reconstructs all original
AST/source origins and supplies that missing ReadField obligation. It changes no
denial outcome or mutation authority. metadata_correspondence.py checks baseline
and mutated raw directly against those source facts. The original matrix failure,
v2 comparator and actual streams are retained without alteration.
